name: Protein Cookie Chocolate Chip
ingredientsText: PROTEIN BLEND (MILK PROTEIN ISOLATE, WHEY PROTEIN ISOLATE), BUTTER (CREAM, NATURAL FLAVOR), POLYDEXTROSE (PREBIOTIC FIBER), ERYTHRITOL, PALM OIL, UNSWEETENED CHOCOLATE, WATER, CALCIUM CASEINATE, COCOA BUTTER, GLYCERIN, CONTAINS LESS THAN 2% OF THE FOLLOWING: NATURAL FLAVORS, LECITHIN (SUNFLOWER, CANOLA, AND/OR SOY LECITHIN), SEA SALT, BAKING SODA, SODIUM CASEINATE, XANTHAN GUM, SUCRALOSE, STEVIA SWEETENER.
mayContainStatement: PROCESSED ON EQUIPMENT THAT ALSO PROCESSES EGGS, WHEAT, PEANUTS, AND TREE NUTS.
notes: Casein, caseinate, whey and butter are milk. The equipment statement is the only source for egg, wheat, peanut and tree nut.
